attchmntText: Autoline Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Autoline Industries Limited filed a notice with BSE and NSE regarding the publication of financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company published advertisements in Financial Express and Loksatta on November 07, 2026. The filing was signed by Company Secretary Pranvesh Tripathi in Pune on November 08, 2026. The document includes a Marathi newspaper advertisement detailing the annual general meeting schedule. The meeting is scheduled for November 11, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM, and November 26, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM. A physical meeting is also set for November 27, 2026, from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM. The advertisement lists registered office addresses in Kolhapur and Pune. It outlines voting procedures and mentions the company's registered office location. The notice serves as a formal record of these disclosures with the stock exchanges.

attchmntText: Autoline Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 06, 2026, titled "PRESS RELEASE FOR QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026".
Autoline Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
